subject: Regional model-fit recap & next steps (EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lind <anna.lind@nordicretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Recap + model recommendations for EU/APAC localization checks

Anna — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and the concrete next steps we discussed so the team has a single source of truth.

Summary of the ask
- Validate fit for product QA + shopper-facing search & chat across Nordic (sv/da/nb), German, French, and APAC (zh-HK, th, vi) locales.
- Latency goal: P95 < 400ms for short chat turns; batch embed throughput target for search.
- Privacy: data will remain in customer-controlled S3 during the pilot (we discussed SOC2 & DPA requirements).

Recommended model suite (initial candidate list)
- EU primary: RW-Chat-8k-v2 (mixed-precision, tuned for instruction following in German/French) — good balance of latency and quality for European languages.
- Nordic-focused: bloomz-7b1-mt + locale-adapted prompt templates (we'll run a focused prompt calibration pass) — cheaper fall-back for high-throughput use cases.
- APAC pilot: mtran-13b-multilang-quant (8-bit) for zh-HK/vi; for Thai we expect an additional fine-tune / lexicon boost step.

Planned evaluation metrics (what we'll compute)
- Structured QA: exact-match / F1 on your ground-truth label set.
- Conversational quality: BLEU + human-rated fluency/adequacy for localized replies (we'll sample 200 per locale).
- Regression checks: token-level perplexity delta vs baseline and hallucination rate on entity recall tests.

Attachments & links
- Attached: EU-APAC-prompt-sets-v2.csv (initial prompts for each locale), initial-benchmark-summary.pdf (short summary of where we expect lift/risk).
- Evaluation dashboard (read-only): https://redwood.app/evals/DEAL-2381/summary

Immediate asks from us
1) Share a secure sample export (5k examples ideally spread by locale). A presigned S3 link works.
2) Confirm which locales are highest priority for this pilot (Nordic subset + Thai?).
3) Any internal privacy contacts we should loop into the DPA/SOC2 conversation?

Timeline (proposal)
- Aug 2: secure dataset received
- Aug 3–10: automated evals + prompt calibration runs
- Aug 11–15: human review for sampled failures + final recommendation

If that all looks good I'll start the eval plan and cc Neha to align on pricing/pilot credits.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-1212 | priyom@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — Inference made predictable.

From: Anna Lind <anna.lind@nordicretail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Hsu <peter.hsu@nordicretail.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + model recommendations for EU/APAC localization checks

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with what our product team is worried about. A few clarifications: 

- Dataset: I'll prepare a presigned S3 link with 5,200 examples (mix of support chats, search logs, and product Q&A) — mostly sv/da/nb, DE, FR, plus small buckets for zh-HK, vi, th. Expect the link by Mon (Aug 2).
- Priority: top priority is Swedish (sv) and Thai (th) — we've seen the most customer complaints in those locales.
- Security/compliance: procurement will want SOC2 Type II report and our legal team will need the DPA. Peter is our procurement lead (cc'd).

Question: can you confirm how Redwood handles tokenization for Thai (no whitespace) and whether you do any locale-specific normalization or sentencepiece customization in the serving path? Also please include expected cost for the pilot (2 weeks of evaluation runs + 100k embed units).

We'll sign an NDA if you send one; otherwise we can run the evals on the presigned link and redact PII before sending.

Best,
Anna
Anna Lind
Head of Product Localization | NordicRetail AB
anna.lind@nordicretail.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lind <anna.lind@nordicretail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + model recommendations for EU/APAC localization checks

Anna — great, thanks for confirming priorities. Short answers and plan: 

Tokenization & Thai handling
- We use a hybrid tokenizer stack: sentencepiece + locale-specific pre-tokenizers for Thai/Chinese to better segment word boundaries. For Thai specifically we apply an optional lexicon-based segmentation pass (configurable per-customer) which improves entity recall in our internal tests. We'll enable that for the initial runs.

Locale-specific normalization
- Yes — simple unicode normalization + locale rules (date/currency) are applied in the ingest pipeline; we do not alter user-visible content beyond normalization unless you ask.

Pilot cost and credits (estimate)
- Evaluation run (2 weeks): approx $4,200 in compute + 100k embed units estimated at $1,200 = $5,400 total. We can cover up to $3k as pilot credits for this eval; Neha will follow up with the pricing proposal.

Attached: eval-plan.md (how we'll run the automated metrics + human sampling), and a slightly updated prompt set (EU-APAC-prompt-sets-v2.csv). We will start the automated runs as soon as the presigned link is available.

Next step: if you can share the presigned link and confirm NDA preference (we can send a one-way NDA), we'll queue the runs for Aug 3.

—Priyom

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lind <anna.lind@nordicretail.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-31T13:05:00Z
Subject: Intro: procurement & pricing for NordicRetail (pilot proposal)

Anna / Peter — looping in commercial to outline pilot terms and next steps on contracting.

Pilot commercial outline
- Deal id: DEAL-2381 (internal hubspot link below)
- Pilot scope: 2-week evaluation as scoped by Priyom; includes 100k embed units + automated eval runs across listed locales.
- Pilot credit: Redwood covers $3,000 of compute; remaining estimated spend ~$2,400 invoiced as usage.
- Post-pilot: we can propose a Dedicated pool or private deployment if results justify it; we'll prepare both an opex and a committed-option pricing sheet.

Compliance & procurement asks
- We will provide SOC2 Type II report and standard DPA. For GDPR data processing specifics let's note: customer will retain raw data in S3 and grant Redwood a read-only presigned link for evaluation only. We'll include processing metadata retention settings in the DPA appendix.

Attachments
- pricing-pilot-proposal.pdf (attached)

Peter — could you confirm procurement timeline and whether you need a reseller PO or if a Redwood invoice is acceptable? Also confirm the legal contact for the DPA.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2381

Thanks — Neha

Date: 2027-08-01T16:45:00Z
Subject: Next steps & dates — summary (action items)

Short summary & commitments:
- Aug 2 (EOD): NordicRetail to provide presigned S3 link with 5.2k examples (Anna).
- Aug 3–10: Redwood to run automated evals + prompt calibration (Priyom).
- Aug 11–15: Human review and localized failure analysis (joint).
- Aug 16: Final recommendation (model + runbook + estimated TCO) delivered to Anna/Peter.
- Aug 30: Procurement target (invoice/PO to be finalized) — Neha/Anna/Peter.

Deliverables from Redwood:
- Eval report (incl. per-locale metrics + hallucination & regression checks) — link to read-only dashboard: https://redwood.app/evals/DEAL-2381/summary
- Prompt set v2 (attached) and suggested fallback model map for cost vs latency trade-offs.
- SOC2/DPA package (Neha will send legal contacts the documents).

Open questions / risks:
- Thai: may require small fine-tune to hit your quality bar — if so we'll provide a separate SOW.
- Human sampling: confirm whether your internal annotators will participate or you want Redwood to run the labeling (estimate attached in eval-plan.md).

If everyone agrees I'll mark the timeline in our tracker and start the runs when the presigned link is up.

Thanks all — looking forward to this pilot.
—Priyom
